details: Windows 1.0.70 COM5 (same cable/port read a UV-5RM fine) and macOS 1.0.70: the first handshake byte was 0x50, the start of the echoed PROGRAMCOLORPROU. CPS v1.0.7 HandShake reads byte by byte, ignores non-ACK bytes and resends every 1 s up to 5 times; stock CHIRP reads one byte and aborts. Likely plug not fully seated on the Mini.
summary: PROGRAMCOLORPROU answered 'P' (echoed command); stock stops as 'Unexpected response'
